name: Rewrite text to adjust specific tone
description: Users asked to rewrite or rephrase provided texts to adjust specific tonal attributes, such as shifting between formal and informal registers, softening confrontational language, or adding cheerfulness and politeness. Some requests also involved formatting content for specific contexts like report cards, legal documents, or invitations, or converting text into active voice or first-person perspectives.
